independent_information_justification: Shin's insider-trader model implies non-uniform margin allocation, and Strumbelj (2014) reported that Shin-derived probabilities can outperform basic normalization in sports odds. Football AI currently needs an empirical project-specific answer rather than assuming one de-vig method is universally best.
